trajectory_summary: This call never had a real foothold: the customer questioned legitimacy almost immediately, stated disinterest and lack of money within the first 70 seconds, and the eventual renter disclosure at 02:35 was a hard, unavoidable DQ. The rep's handling was thin throughout — repeated vague legitimacy claims, a features-first response to a money objection, and a fast, unresisted exit once the DQ surfaced — but the DQ itself means no version of better handling was going to produce a booked appointment.
outcome_dispute: The call is correctly a DQ (not_homeowner, dq_rules), so v1's likely tag of a failed/no-appointment call is directionally right; the dispute is only that the underlying legitimacy and objection-handling gaps happened well before the DQ surfaced and would have been coaching-relevant even on a qualified lead.
